name: long-pipeline
stdin:
NAME := app
VERSION = 1.2
SRCS := $(wildcard src/*.c)
OBJS := $(patsubst src/%.c,build/%.o,$(SRCS))
HDRS := $(wildcard src/*.h)
.PHONY: all clean dist
all: build/$(NAME)
build/$(NAME): $(OBJS) | build
	@echo linking $@ from $(words $(OBJS)) objects
	link -o $@ $^
build:
	mkdir build
	touch build
build/%.o: src/%.c $(HDRS) | build
	compile $< -> $@
dist: build/$(NAME)
	tar $(NAME)-$(VERSION).tar $<
	touch $(NAME)-$(VERSION).tar
clean:
	rm -f $(OBJS) build/$(NAME)
